title: [Flight] Avoid main-thread stalls from large debug strings

posted.message: Truncating an arbitrary string with `slice(0, 1023)` can split a UTF-16 surrogate pair in half (e.g., an emoji or certain non-Latin characters) if it lands on the boundary. While modern V8 environments safely escape unpaired surrogates in `JSON.stringify` (producing sequences like `"\ud83d"`), this may still result in rendering a broken character block (like ) in DevTools. Consider checking if the character at index 1022 is a high surrogate before slicing, and decrementing the slice index by 1 if it is.

posted.message: If `flush()` throws an error internally (e.g. from `resolveFileComplete` or `resolveField`), it consumes the error, calls `busboyStream.destroy(error)`, and returns out of the loop. If `flush()` was called by the `finish` event handler (or if the `finish` event handler happens to execute shortly after while the stream is destroying), `closed` remains false. This subsequently triggers `reportGlobalError(..., new Error('Reply finished with incomplete file part.'))`, polluting the response with a generic secondary error rather than surfacing the original parsing error that triggered `destroy()`. Consider verifying `!busboyStream.destroyed` or tracking initialization of destruction.

title: Layer written outside the output location of '//' exception is thrown when using extract layers in root directory

posted.message: Including the `--launcher` flag causes the command to extract launcher classes directly into the destination folder. Because the destination is purposefully set to the file system root (`/` or `C:\`), the test will attempt to extract any non-application test files (e.g., `test/spring-boot-loader/...`) directly to the host's root directory (e.g., `/test/`). On UNIX environments running without root privileges, this results in an `AccessDeniedException` and causes the test to fail. On environments where writes to root are permitted, this results in system pollution. To fix this, remove `--launcher` from the `runCommand` arguments. The `--layers` flag is sufficient to verify the layer directory fix.

posted.message: `MavenRepositorySystemUtils.newSession()` has been deprecated since Maven Resolver 1.9.0. It creates a `DefaultRepositorySystemSession` which skips modern resource cleanup. It is recommended to use `SessionBuilder` to create a `CloseableSession` and clean it up after use to prevent potential resource leaks.
